name: filesystem exclusive create error code
source: import { rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; function main(): void { const path = '/tmp/thaw-exclusive-error'; rmSync(path, { force: true }); writeFileSync(path, 'first'); try { writeFileSync(path, 'second', { flag: 'wx' }); } catch (error) { console.log(error.name, error.code); } rmSync(path); }
